answer: Use rotating time-signal check-ins. Each agent registers one device key, then each epoch signs the signal code from three clocks within two hours. Codes hash-chain together, so they cannot be precomputed or replayed, and missing two windows suspends the identity pending recheck. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 devices online and operators for 6,000 signings a week at $4 each, about $24,000 weekly plus 250 staff hours. Like nectar guarded by bees returning home, ember kept alive only by daily tending, and jade proved by years of use, presence must be earned again each epoch.
